<script>

import StudentSearchComponent from './studentSearch/StudentSearchComponent.vue';
export default {
  name: "studentSearch",
  components: {StudentSearchComponent},
  data() {
    return {
      tabs: ["Simple Search", "Advanced Search", "Seat Number Search"],
      selectedTab: "Simple Search",
      searchList: [],
      isSearch: false,
      duPRN: '',
      oldPRN: '',
      elgFormNo: '',
      applFormNumber: '',
      lastName: '',
      firstName: '',
      fatherName: '',
      motherName: '',
      studyCenterCode: ''
    };
  },
  methods: {
    showTab(tab) 
    {
      this.selectedTab = tab;
    },
    search () 
    {
      SearchStudent();
        this.isSearch = !this.isSearch
    },
   
    
  },
};
</script>
